headline: What agreements is Uzbekistan reaching with neighboring countries on water and electricity exchange? Minister's comment
summary: Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan are coordinating electricity supply and water releases from reservoirs to meet agricultural needs. Minister Shavkat Khamrayev described how the mechanism works and its role in water diplomacy.
why: Water and power exchanges between Central Asian states affect energy supply, irrigation for farm output and regional economic planning.
